title: Should update remove the module docs and instructions folders from a team's planning reading?
context: paqad shipped docs/modules/** and docs/instructions/** as planning reading until 2026-10-28, and a stock 1.116 file no longer has them. A team may also have chosen them on purpose. A removed path comes off on every update, so a team that wants one could only keep it by writing the path differently.
